claims.claim_summary: Third, LinUOT tracks OnTrack within 0.003–0.010 AUROC everywhere: the quadratic term contributes essentially nothing to ranking on this corpus, consistent with its role as a false-alarm suppressor rather than a ranker (Table 4); the mask-free variant is AUROC-identical to the full system, confirming the mask’s null ranking effect here as well.
